'''Lyt Re''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|171|Jokot}}</ref> Re conspired with the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Kelna Toodo]] to help deceive a group of individuals into acquiring the [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|Barzo cargo freighter]] ''[[Radiant Splendor]]''. Toodo had been tasked by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]]-owner [[Beeda]] with eliminating the individuals after they had meddled with Beeda's affairs, and the Duros planned to set a trap for his targets aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. In the run-down [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[The White Door]], in the port town [[Akmalla]] on a [[Planet/Legends|world]] near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], Toodo lured the individuals into participating in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game against himself, Re, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jokot]] and the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Lar-Odo]], and on Toodo's instructions, Re posed as the owner of the ''Radiant Splendor'' and deliberately played badly throughout the game. She lost many hands and pretended to grow more nervous as the game progressed, and for her final hand, she staked the ''Radiant Splendor'' and lost it to the individuals. Re then finished her drink and stormed out, and she made her way to a nearby [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]]. The individuals subsequently took possession of the ''Radiant Splendor'' and they were able to thwart Toodo's plot.<ref name="Cat and Mouse" />
